name: echo mushroom hd b
description: Proposal, 60 cell lattice (8 px cells), faithful: echoMushroom frame for frame at 3x with every new shape redrawn fine; a red toadstool with white spots, white gills and a shaded stem sprouts beside the creature and hops into a round open mouth, three chews and a gulp, then the eyes pop round in a visor band grown across the face and the pupils dilate (8 cells across in the pop, then 12, as the eyes overshoot square and settle round) into black discs inside a one cell white ring, one 2 x 2 highlight held still at the top of each eye while the pupils drift a cell round an eight point loop in mirror, 150 ms a step and 1.2 s a turn for 2.4 s, the creature swaying three cells each way under an open grin with a red tongue and an antenna ping once a turn, as the sky opens out of the eyes in a ping and white rimmed disc to fill rows 0..50 (deep #3b8bff over light #7cc4ff, a 4 x 4 dither between) with one near cumulus drifting left at 150 ms a cell and two far clouds at 240; then the head tips back three rows, the pupils roll up two rows and look slowly round the top of the eyes for 4 s before the sky folds back into the eyes and they close down to the family's own; judge whether the dilated black pupils read as delighted rather than spooky, and whether the drift reads with the highlight held still.
